reviewNotes: Leo's complete five-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, retaining his reflective, studious and childlike voice, with the player placeholder and all controls exact.

winter_15.000.source: I just like looking at the lights.#$b#It reminds me of something, long, long ago...$s
winter_15.000.translation: Îmi place doar să privesc luminile.#$b#Îmi amintesc de ceva petrecut cu foarte, foarte mult timp în urmă...$s

winter.000.source: It's going to take a while, but I'm trying to get through all the books in the library.#$b#I have a lot of catching up to do...$s
winter.000.translation: O să dureze ceva, dar încerc să citesc toate cărțile din bibliotecă.#$b#Am multe de recuperat...$s

school.source: Can't talk right now, @. I have to really focus...
school.translation: Nu pot vorbi acum, @. Trebuie să mă concentrez foarte bine...

dinner.source: Oh, are you hungry? I already finished all the food...$u
dinner.translation: O, îți este foame? Am terminat deja toată mâncarea...$u

tent.source: We don't mind the rain too much, but it's nice to dry off in here sometimes.
tent.translation: Ploaia nu ne deranjează prea mult, dar este plăcut să ne mai uscăm uneori aici, la adăpost.
